title: What’s One More?
content:
What’s one more? One more lap, one more climb, one more descent, one more hour.

It’s a simple question, but after nearly 23 hours, it’s not as simple an answer as it may seem. At a point, it stops being a physical limit and becomes a conversation with yourself. How far are you willing to go, and how much more can you squeeze out of the already nearly empty tank?

“This ride wasn’t about numbers or records. It was about following curiosity wherever it leads, even when it takes far longer, hurts far more, and makes far less sense than anyone, including yourself, could imagine. That’s the story I want to share. The finish matters, but so does the thinking that gets you there: where the idea comes from, how the goal changes, and the decision to commit again when you’ve already done a huge amount.”
